banner.title: kube-state-metrics
banner.tagline: Turns the Kubernetes API into Prometheus series: pod phases, restarts, failed Jobs and extended node resources.

art.about: how kube-state-metrics turns API objects into series
art.title: How kube-state-metrics reads the API

explainer.title: From an API object to a series

steps.title: Watch
steps.text: The Deployment lists and watches the API server for the object kinds it supports by default, cluster-wide.
steps.scene: an eye over a stack of object cards

steps.title: Count
steps.text: Each object becomes gauge or info series, such as kube_pod_status_phase or kube_node_status_allocatable.
steps.scene: series of tally marks on a board

steps.title: Scrape
steps.text: Prometheus scrapes the 8080 port through a ServiceMonitor whose job is kube-state-metrics. Honored labels keep each object's own namespace.
steps.scene: a probe drawing data from a grid of cards

steps.title: Self
steps.text: Its own health is on port 8081: list and watch errors. The chart's KubeStateMetrics rules read those series.
steps.scene: a heartbeat trace on a small panel
